subject: hospitality-tourism

source.track: IGCSE · ages 14–16 · single written examination covering all five subject topics

note: Units follow the syllabus's five numbered topics in teaching order, with the broad Global tourism topic split at its sub-headings into demand and appeal, and destination management. Definitions and the scale of tourism anchor the foundational lessons; organisations, customer service and destination marketing feed the intermediate lessons, with destination management and marketing analysis carrying the advanced lesson.
